title: Organizational Behaviour and Change Management
description: Techniques for the management of individual, group and intergroup behaviour in health care organizations, including decision making and problem solving, work groups, leadership, power and influence, labour relations, process engineering and risk management.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HINF 230, COM 220.
